title: Contracts
intro: Every contract in the catalog — APIs, event streams and data views — with its owner and highest version.
createIntro: Where the contract lives, what it is called and who owns it. The first version's document comes next.
empty: No contracts yet — create one or import a document
notFound: This contract does not exist (or was deleted).

field.typeHint: The standard the documents follow — fixed once the contract exists
field.typeLocked: The type cannot change: every version is validated against it
field.systemHint: The application or service exposing this contract
field.systemLocked: A contract stays in the system it was created in
field.ownerHint: A team you belong to, or yourself; administrators may pick anyone
field.ownerLocked: Only an administrator can transfer ownership
field.ownerTransferHint: Picking another owner transfers the contract

releaseLines.title: Release lines
releaseLines.loadFailed: Could not load the release lines
releaseLines.recommendedHint: Leave empty to recommend the highest active stable version automatically.
releaseLines.recommendationsLoadFailed: Could not load the versions available for recommendation
releaseLines.saveConflict: The release line changed — close the dialog and try again
releaseLines.replacementHint: Search contracts, then optionally select a release line.
releaseLines.differentLineRequired: For this contract, choose a different release line.
releaseLines.planHint: Dates are advisory and evaluated in UTC. They do not change version lifecycle or support status. Followers receive in-app reminders within 30 days, within 7 days, and when a deadline is reached.
releaseLines.usageScope: These are architecture relationships for the whole contract. Explicit version and major-line declarations are shown separately; runtime adoption remains unknown. No declared consumers does not prove that retirement is safe.
releaseLines.incompleteUsage: Usage information is incomplete, stale, or unavailable. Review the known consumers and coordinate the migration before proceeding.
releaseLines.acknowledgeImpact: I have reviewed the declared usage and its limitations and choose to proceed.
releaseLines.endSupportHint: This ends support for the release line. It does not retire individual versions.
releaseLines.dateOrder: Deprecation must be on or before the support-end date.
releaseLines.reportHint: The download uses the latest saved plan and latest cached usage observation; unsaved policy edits are not included.
releaseLines.downloadReportFailed: Could not download the migration report. Try again.
releaseLines.downloadReportTooLarge: This report exceeds the 8 MiB export limit. No file was downloaded. Review the complete usage in Covenant.

report.title: Migration and retirement impact report
report.name: Contract name
report.scopeWarning: This report contains cached architecture usage for the whole contract. Runtime version and major-line adoption remain unknown; explicit upstream declarations are listed separately below.
report.emptyWarning: No observed declared usage is not proof that the contract is unused or that retirement is safe.
report.incompleteWarning: Usage is incomplete, stale, refreshing, or unavailable; retained rows may come from the last successful observation.
report.adoptionWarning: These are upstream declarations, not runtime evidence. Parallel, conflicting, and unmatched declarations are retained without choosing a winner.

adoptionAvailability.NOT_CONFIGURED: Declared adoption was not configured for this snapshot.
adoptionAvailability.NOT_SCANNED: Declared adoption was configured but not scanned for this snapshot.
adoptionAvailability.BLUEPRINT_MISSING: The configured adoption blueprint was missing from this snapshot.
adoptionAvailability.AVAILABLE: No explicit adoption declarations were present in this snapshot.

report.noObservedUsage: No declared usage was observed in this snapshot. This does not prove that the contract is unused or that retirement is safe.
report.usageUnavailable: No numeric usage conclusion is available from this incomplete snapshot. Unknown usage is not zero usage.

validation.descriptionLength: Description must be at most 2000 characters

saveForbidden: You cannot edit this contract — only its owners and administrators can
saveConflict: A contract with this name already exists in this system
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This contract no longer exists — reload the page
deleteBody: "{{name}}" and its {{count}} version(s) will be deleted.
deleteHasPublished: This contract still has active or deprecated versions — retire them first.
importIntro: Paste, upload or fetch a contract document. It lands as a new version — of the contract with that name in the picked system, or of a new contract.
importVersionHint: Prefilled from the document's declared version
importOwnerHint: Needed only when the contract does not exist yet
importPlaceholder: Paste the OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or ODCS document here…
importHint: Check predicts the outcome without storing anything; Import stores the document, waiving soft findings.
importInvalid: The request was refused — check the fields

importStatus.CREATED: Contract created with its first version
importStatus.CREATED_WITH_FINDINGS: Contract created — the version carries findings
importStatus.INVALID: Not imported — the document or the version was rejected
importStatus.CONFLICT: Not imported — this version already exists
importStatus.FORBIDDEN: Not imported — you cannot write this contract

importCheckStatus.CREATED: Would create the contract with this version
importCheckStatus.CREATED_WITH_FINDINGS: Would create the contract — the version would carry findings
importCheckStatus.VERSION_ADDED_WITH_FINDINGS: Would add this version — it would carry findings
importCheckStatus.INVALID: Would be rejected — the document or the version
importCheckStatus.CONFLICT: Would be rejected — this version already exists
importCheckStatus.FORBIDDEN: Would be refused — you cannot write this contract
